sources.observation: A broad elliptical dish tilts above a grey concrete rotunda and two splayed yoke arms. Three braces carry a rectangular feed cabin.

limitations: The dish is fixed at a representative observing angle. Lattice members, mechanical housings and service details are exterior interpretations. Nearby offices and visitor buildings remain native.
